# Test fixtures

Two unmodified GLB files from the Solander 38 website
(github.com/risingtideresearch/solander-38-website @ 15ae34a), used to check
that the scene decodes what that site ships (EXT_meshopt_compression +
KHR_mesh_quantization):

| file | original name |
|---|---|
| `solander-freezer.glb` | `models-1789414952/OUTFITTING_INTERIOR__Isotherm Drawer 55 – Frost Free Freezer.glb` (one mesh, an unnamed Rhino display colour) |
| `solander-battery-cell.glb` | `models-battery-1789233002/BATTERY MODULE V2__BATTERY CELL BASE__CELL.glb` (one mesh used by 8 nodes) |
